verdict.rationale: ClickUp's integrations directory says it syncs issues (plus commits, branches and PRs) between GitHub and ClickUp, and links GitLab issues with ClickUp tasks, so a first-party repo issue-tracker integration exists. The evidence is only one-line directory blurbs. They never explicitly confirm that task and issue edits propagate both ways, and the GitLab entry says "link" rather than sync. missing for 10: explicit confirmation of bi-directional field/status sync, details on which fields sync and how conflicts are handled, in-depth integration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
